# HotClip

> HotClip (中文名「爆款切片」) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), local-first AI video clipper for Windows, macOS and Linux (experimental). It turns long videos and livestream replays into viral 9:16 vertical shorts: AI highlight detection with virality scores and auditable reasoning, selected-picture-consistent multimodal analysis, local speech-aware safe cuts, comfort-first per-shot auto-reframe, metadata-gated PQ/HLG HDR-to-SDR BT.709 output, quality-ranked final-render covers, optional clip-local adaptive picture finishing, frozen-frame and subject-crop render QA, dynamic word-level captions, filler-word/silence removal, speaker diarization. No credit system, no watermark, no uploads, no sign-up, no video-length caps — everything runs on the user's own machine. Native Chinese + English. A free local alternative to OpusClip, Klap, Vizard and CapCut/剪映智能切片 (whose smart clipping is paywalled). Current release: v0.26.0 (2026-08).

## Key facts

- Price: free, open source (AGPL-3.0-only); no paid tier, no account system
- Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple Silicon), Linux (experimental AppImage); double-click installer, no Python/Docker
- Processing: 100% local (ASR via sherpa-onnx: SenseVoice / Paraformer / FireRedASR2; speaker diarization via pyannote + 3D-Speaker; ffmpeg + libass export)
- LLM highlight detection: bring your own key (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) or local Ollama for a fully offline pipeline; the LLM only picks passages — timestamps are reverse-aligned from the word-level transcript, never guessed
- Nine evidence channels for highlights: transcript, loudness peaks, shot-cut density, lightweight motion, facial-expression peaks, optional vision model, live-chat (danmaku) heat with anti-spam caps and interaction-event weighting (Bilibili .xml and Douyin .jsonl chat logs), vocal tone, laughter/applause
- Reusable evidence: source-fingerprinted Tier-0 signals, TransNetV2 boundaries and optional vision-scan outcomes share a bounded 64MB local index across desktop, CLI, MCP, folder watch and webhooks; model/detector changes invalidate safely and API keys are never persisted
- Speech-safe cuts: a SHA-256-verified 629KB local VAD model corroborates ASR before automatic outer-edge refinement, protects ASR-missed quiet speech inside jump-cut gaps, maps the same selected audio track as final render, records coverage/deltas/protected gaps, and falls back exactly when evidence is weak or unavailable
- Output: 9:16 vertical clips with comfort-first composition and local PQ/HLG tone mapping to social-compatible SDR BT.709 only for the verified BT.2020/BT.2020 non-constant-matrix TV/full-range input path. Motion, shots, facial emotion, contact sheets, thumbnails and reframing bind the same selected video stream; executable HDR receives the same safe SDR analysis preview. MaxCLL/mastering peak metadata guides highlights when available. Unsupported or incomplete HDR is marked unconverted, while colour-inspection failure is a separate state; both bypass SDR-domain adaptive finishing. Covers are ranked from the final post-QA clip using bounded local FFmpeg metrics, with exact audio-peak fallback. Outputs also include dynamic captions, title cards, -14 LUFS loudness, SRT, publish copy and an auditable clips.json receipt
- Automation: one-click hands-off mode, 24/7 folder watch for stream recordings, headless CLI, local MCP server, Claude Code / Codex agent skill
- Publish & survive (v0.14): transform score previewed before export (pixel-level reposting is 2026's top takedown cause), per-platform publish packs (Douyin/Kuaishou/Bilibili/RedNote/WeChat Channels/TikTok), JianYing (CapCut CN) draft export, AIGC labeling helper, distribution ledger CSV with optional source-evidence archive, anti-fingerprint multi-version variants
- Languages: Chinese (dialects, Cantonese, code-switching) and English; bilingual UI and captions
- Intended use: the user's own content or authorized clips only (e.g. streamer clipping programs)
